title: Source-first v2 contract
summary: This iteration turns the user-confirmed source-first v2 direction into a validator-backed product contract: source signal story precedes the metrics dashboard, logical sources are the reader-facing layer, and the full 154-entry collection inventory remains visible as inventory rather than first-viewport story content.

lessons.lesson: The source-first page needs two explicit layers instead of one oversized list.
lessons.evidence: `config/source-display-contract.json` now defines `reader_source_unit: logical_source` and `inventory_unit: collection_entry`, while `docs/source-first-ia-handbook.md` documents Logical Source Layer and Collection Entry Layer.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future reader-facing source work on logical sources, and keep collection entries as complete inventory evidence.

lessons.lesson: The first viewport should explain the day's source signal before showing the operating dashboard.
lessons.evidence: `presentation_contract.first_viewport_order` is fixed to `source_signal_story` then `source_metrics_dashboard`, and unit tests reject presentation drift.
lessons.recommended_action: Use this order when implementing the runtime layout slice.

lessons.lesson: Full inventory expansion must mean visible inventory, not 154 first-viewport story cards.
lessons.evidence: `docs/ai-daily-requirements-reconciliation.md` and `docs/source-first-ia-handbook.md` both preserve the rule that 154 collection entries are complete inventory rows, not first-viewport story content.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding source search or focus controls, highlight matches without hiding non-matching rows.

followups.action: Implement the runtime page slice in the contract order: source signal story, metrics dashboard, status focus, source map, then full inventory.
